title: FoodGate: The Break-in, the Cover-up, & the Aftermath
summary: A UCTV panel with endocrinologist Robert Lustig, dentist Cristen Kearns and health policy expert Laura Schmidt on how the US food system and sugar industry influence diet and health, including industry efforts to shape the science.
why: HN cites it in threads on sugar, nutrition science and industry influence over health research.

quote.text: This little panel discussion on the sugar industry’s efforts is a great watch.
